result.topic_en: A geometric drawing on a lattice of points (grid of crosses) showing a black triangle and a slightly shifted red triangle with numbered marks along their sides, labelled 7+22i, apparently illustrating a Gaussian integer and lattice-point counting related to biquadratic residues.
